versions.changelog:
- Removed sample file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes made to core functionality or documentation.

Initial release of Markdown转Notion转换器.

- Converts Markdown content into Notion API compatible JSON format via an MCP server.
- Requires users to provide an API key on first use; prompts via AskUserQuestion if missing.
- Clear workflow defined: check API key → select tool → extract parameters → call function → return results.
- Core tool: scripts.tools.markdown_to_notion for markdown-to-Notion conversion.
- Strict rules to avoid making up data when API key is absent.
- Project includes configuration management, API client, and callable tools.
